name: d8x-asm
description: Syntax highlighting, go to definition, find references, hover and outline for Toyota/Denso D8X ECU disassemblies

d8x.references.includeComments.description: Include mentions of a symbol in comment prose in Find All References. IDA's '; CODE XREF:'/'; DATA XREF:' lists are always left out, since each one only mirrors a code reference already found.

d8x.hover.maxCommentLines.description: Most comment lines a symbol's hover shows from the block above its definition and the comment beside it.
